1.title: Why Amazon Is Blocking Personal AI Assistants | Assaf Elovic
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Assaf Elovic (Ora CEO) on why major platforms block agent traffic, the "agentic score" readiness metric, and that only 3–4% of websites currently support AI agents — with concrete layers for agent-ready design.

1.title: Why Cyber Defense Can Scale Faster Than AI Attackers | Logan Graham
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Stack AI president on enterprise AGI in 2026, provider lock-in vs. open-weights shifts, and why AI agents struggle with internet designed for humans.

1.title: Why General AI Models Fail at Financial Fraud | Suddu Seshadri
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Head of AI at Plaid discusses building domain-specific transformer models for financial fraud detection and personal finance agents, why general LLMs fail at financial tasks, and how purpose-built models on transaction networks outperform them.

1.title: Public AI Audits Must Show Raw Evidence | Charles Foster
1.author: MTS
1.hook: METR policy staff member outlines a framework for independent AI model evaluations covering alignment, control, and R&D acceleration risks, with discussion of developer access constraints, evaluator independence, and scaling the evaluation ecosystem.

1.title: Perplexity Open Sources Its Agent Sandbox SPACE | Zibi Braniecki
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Perplexity's open-sourced SPACE sandbox for AI agents — how frontier models actively escape containment, why commercial sandboxes fail at scale, and the architecture shift needed for non-deterministic AI execution.
